decided.question: what does accepting a role = 'client' invitation do when the account already holds a removed ClientMembership, given accountId is unique, requirement 18 says the accept creates one, requirement 2's refusal table names only active rows, and State Machine invariant 2 called removed terminal
decided.chose: the accept restores that row when the invitation names the client the row is already bound to — same id, status active, removedAt and removedByAccountId null, joinedAt the acceptance time, invitedByMembershipId the new inviter — and refuses with 409 CLIENT_USER_MESSAGES.accountLinkedToAnotherClient ("This email address is already linked to a different client") when the invitation names any other client, in this organization or another, leaving the row removed and the invitation pending; removed is no longer terminal and the state diagram draws the transition back
decided.rejected: inserting a second ClientMembership (the unique accountId makes it a 500 requirement 2 forbids by name); refusing every re-admission (no message exists for it and Out of Scope states a fresh invitation is the re-admission path); and rebinding the row's clientId to the newly invited client (it would move a row the old client's requests, messages and events still resolve through, and leave a request whose project belongs to one client addressed to a membership of another, which requirement 26 exists to prevent)
decided.why: rule 2 — user-management spec 03 requirement 5 gives the same shape for staff: a removed membership in the inviting organization is restored to active on acceptance with the joined date reset. Spec 03's other half, hard-deleting a prior membership of a different organization, cannot be copied here because requirement 22 keeps the client row alive so historical requests resolve through it, so the different-client case falls to rule 3 and refuses
decided.recordedAt: requirement 2 — the third and fourth rows of its outcome table and the two Decided paragraphs beneath it; carried into requirement 18, State Machine invariant 1, invariant 2 and the diagram, the ClientMembership Data Model rows for status/invitedByMembershipId/joinedAt/removedAt/removedByAccountId, the new Alt Flow "a removed client contact comes back", the new API Contracts section for POST /api/invitations/accept, edge cases 23 and 24, the Error Messages row for accountLinkedToAnotherClient, the Out of Scope bullets on a restore route and on moving a removed client user, the Known Gaps row on the second email address, AC-14 with its observer row, and TC-02-INT-20

claimsVerified: specs/user-management/03-user-invitation.md requirement 5, "Removed member of the same org" — accepting restores the membership to active and resets the joined date; requirement 6 hard-deletes a prior membership of a different organization
